requirements.visual: Reject physical product renders, floors, tables, reflections and photographic objects. Flat implementable geometric desktop companion.
requirements.interaction: Input beside companion, independent messages accumulate above.
requirements.platforms: Broad audience; Omarchy is initial target, macOS planned later.
requirements.naming: Drop Omarchy prefix. Await user selection of new repository name.
requirements.animation: Simple rotations, polygon transforms, node interpolation or bar scaling, design concepts only.

candidates.name: HALKA
candidates.detail: Label "G01 / HALKA". Companion: three thin concentric incomplete circle arcs with different start angles, one small solid cyan dot traveling on outer arc. 52px overall diameter. White inner arc, muted cyan #80C9CB outer arc, central space EMPTY, no filled sphere. This can animate through simple independent arc rotation and dot motion. Arcs not shown with motion blur. UI minimal sharp near-black rectangles with a single 1px neutralgray edge and a 2px cyan focus segment at input left; small 4px corner radius maximum. Assistant message has a small cyan marker; all text pale gray. Compact and quiet high-precision circular symbol. No glowing rings, no physical orbital objects, no 3D.
candidates.prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. A FLAT 2D SCREENSHOT-STYLE design for a Linux desktop geometric AI companion and its floating chat. Landscape 1536x1024. Absolutely NOT a product render. NO table, NO floor, NO perspective, NO realistic objects, NO studio lighting, NO texture, NO shadows, NO reflections, NO planets, NO 3D, NO photographic elements. The whole image is flat #202329 solid desktop color, edge to edge. Every visible element should be simple shapes realistically implementable in SVG/CSS or Canvas: circles, lines, polygons, flat fills, subtle opacity. No elaborate particles or impossible optical effects. Design futuristic by geometry, precision and restrained color, not 3D. Companion must be small, about 48–64px, a simple abstract geometric symbol, NO face, NO robot, NO pixel art. Refined UI clean sans-serif typography. Draw TWO states side by side with small labels "İlk açılış" and "Konuşurken", same bottom baseline around 780px. First has ONLY small geometric companion beside one 390x48px input. Second has same companion/input with THREE independent small message boxes above it. Exact sample messages: "GitHub’ı aç.", "GitHub açıldı.", "Bir de Spotify’ı aç.". Input "Bir şey yaz..." and small arrow at far right. Individual messages float on desktop, no enclosing parent window, no titlebar, no greeting, no toolbar, no buttons except send. Right-align user messages, left-align assistant message. No decorative connector lines unrelated to specified design. No superimposed physical background; desktop remains visible between messages. Large quiet negative space, bounded compact widgets. One modest concept label at upper left as specified. All lines crisp, no blur, no bloom. No large mascot hero illustration. CRUCIAL: companion and UI are FLAT interface graphics at actual desktop scale, not material renderings.
Label "G01 / HALKA". Companion: three thin concentric incomplete circle arcs with different start angles, one small solid cyan dot traveling on outer arc. 52px overall diameter. White inner arc, muted cyan #80C9CB outer arc, central space EMPTY, no filled sphere. This can animate through simple independent arc rotation and dot motion. Arcs not shown with motion blur. UI minimal sharp near-black rectangles with a single 1px neutralgray edge and a 2px cyan focus segment at input left; small 4px corner radius maximum. Assistant message has a small cyan marker; all text pale gray. Compact and quiet high-precision circular symbol. No glowing rings, no physical orbital objects, no 3D.

candidates.name: KAT
candidates.detail: Label "G02 / KAT". Companion: four separate flat unequal triangular polygons forming an asymmetric open diamond/arrowhead, with narrow dark gaps. 52px high. Colors muted apricot #D69C7D, pale cream #E6D7C9, muted rust #925C49. No shading or perspective, just four 2D colored pieces. This can animate with small translation and rotation of polygons, not fluid simulation. UI angular clipped-corner flat near-black message boxes with one thin muted apricot top border. Composer has 6px diagonal corner cuts at top-right/bottom-left and a simple apricot send chevron. Assistant message slightly warm light surface #D8CCC0 with dark text, user messages dark. Refined geometric composition, subtle warm palette, no light effects or realistic crystal.

candidates.name: DUGUM
candidates.detail: Label "G03 / DUGUM". Companion: four small flat filled circular nodes joined by three VERY THIN straight lines, forming an asymmetric compact constellation/diamond. Overall 56x48px. Largest center node pale lavender #BAACD6, two small nodes muted lavender #817397 and one tiny ivory node; no glow. Motion achievable through node position interpolation and small scale pulses. Entire symbol looks like a clean graphical mark, no sphere shading. UI independent thin lavender-outlined flat dark rectangles with 8px rounded corners, softly different purple-black fill from desktop, clean off-white text. Input a matching narrow rounded rectangle, white/lavender simple send arrow. Assistant message on slightly lighter dusty violet flat surface. No texture, no hologram, no gradients. Calm connected geometry, visible lines and nodes.

candidates.name: AKIS
candidates.detail: Label "G04 / AKIS". Companion: five slim parallel VERTICAL rounded bars of unequal heights making a compact asymmetric waveform, 52px wide by 38px tall. Pure flat sea-green #9AB8A0 and pale sage #D2DFD3, no gradients. This can animate only by scaling bar heights. Not a voice-assistant microphone icon, no enclosing circle. UI like floating understated horizontal strips: square corners, muted olive charcoal #292F2C fill, single thin sage BOTTOM border on composer and each message. No complete outline frames. User message strips right-aligned, assistant strip left-aligned with a little sage square at left. Typography warm offwhite, composer sends with a small plain right arrow. Clear horizontal visual rhythm, airy desktop graphics. No stereo hardware, no realistic materials, no soundwave trails.
